description: Phase S0 frozen baseline definition for the SQLite storage runtime plan. Freezes distinct product/evidence binary identities plus the released schema identity and defines current, 10x, open-loop overload, crash, recovery, FTS, backup/restore, and A/A noise-floor workloads across the supported store families. Product command templates remain null unless a checked-in command can cover the complete phase against an explicitly supplied isolated fixture copy. The runner fails closed on pending steps unless --allow-pending is passed. This file defines the contract; it is not yet evidence.

frozen_identity.notes: The schema manifest/config are operator-supplied released artifacts. The freeze separately binds product and evidence binaries plus schema, workload, corpus, and config hashes; it never derives identity from a live profile.

safety.notes: The runner, not the workload, creates and sets TRACEDECAY_DATA_DIR/TRACEDECAY_GLOBAL_DB under each fresh runner-owned store copy. Protected child roots cannot be overridden; child processes never inherit TRACEDECAY_* implicitly.

latency.coordinated_omission: open-loop latency is measured from the scheduled issue time; closed-loop issues strictly sequentially

phases.name: current
phases.pending_reason: requires an existing product command that performs the frozen write/read mix for graph, profile, project, and session stores using only explicit fixture paths; no such checked-in CLI or standalone test-binary interface exists

phases.name: ten_x
phases.pending_reason: requires the same explicit-path product write/read command as current plus a released 10x corpus; no such checked-in CLI or standalone test-binary interface exists

phases.name: overload
phases.pending_reason: requires an explicit-path product write command with documented saturation outcomes for all four store families; the checked-in CLI exposes no such standalone command
phases.notes: offered/admitted/completed/shed/retried are recorded per family; latency is measured from scheduled issue time so queueing is included

phases.name: crash
phases.pending_reason: the fixed storage-runtime-crash-recovery-repair-v1 product adapter command now drives an isolated ready-signalled crash through MaintenanceCoordinator and real S5/S6 recovery APIs, but qualifying copied fixtures have not yet been executed for this S0 phase

phases.name: recovery
phases.pending_reason: the fixed storage-runtime-crash-recovery-repair-v1 adapter command now exercises SqliteDoctorHealthLane, SqliteCorruptionProbe, SqliteRepairDriver, and FilesystemQuarantineStore, but qualifying corrupt/recoverable copied fixtures have not yet produced accepted typed evidence

phases.name: fts
phases.pending_reason: product_adapter.py now constructs real tracedecay tool search and message_search JSON probes, but execution requires an explicitly supplied released fixture copy with storage-runtime-fixture-v1.json, project/profile roots, and fixture-owned graph/session query text; no qualifying storage/session database fixture is checked in

phases.name: backup_restore
phases.pending_reason: the fixed storage-runtime-backup-restore-v1 product adapter command now exercises BackupRoot, FilesystemBackupStore, SqliteOnlineBackupDriver, RestorePublicationAuthority, and BackupRestoreOrchestrator, but a qualifying copied fixture has not yet produced accepted typed backup/restore evidence

phases.name: aa_noise
phases.notes: A/A pairs establish the per-platform noise floor; regression margins for current and 10x are noise_floor * margin_multiplier and must be re-recorded on Linux, Windows, and macOS

limitations: all S0 workload command templates remain pending; S11 now exposes fixed S6 maintenance/Doctor/repair/backup/restore evidence gates, but qualifying copied fixtures still must be executed and accepted
A/A noise floors are per-machine and must be re-baselined per platform
network filesystems are out of scope per the plan's fail-closed policy
